title: General Material Blend 3-Mix Duo #07 (대각 띠·매끈 / 동심원·물결 | 공작눈무늬+목재+코이비늘 / 흑요암금+코이비늘+목재)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Uzbek, in her early 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in curly, real pores, real living eyes, 5 bars piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in copper-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of platinum a bracelet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 45% of the way down her figure from the top and about 72% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Thai, in her early 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, soft rose-gold hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real pores, real living eyes, 50 segment rings piercings set with diamonds in bronze-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of mixed-metal a necklace. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 46% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 26% and 41% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID ORANGE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
